items.description: Replacement of stolen household contents (clothing, personal effects, everyday jewellery)
items.rationale: Forcible removal 2.6 with movable property presumably co-insured; everyday jewellery and clothing are paid in full under 4.4.5/4.4.6, but undifferentiated presentation under 9.6 risks treatment as a single unspecified article capped at EUR 1,000.

items.description: Emergency repair and re-securing of forced entry door
items.rationale: Covered under 2.6.2 and 5.2.2 securing head, capped at EUR 1,000 incl. VAT per event; like-for-like door re-securing customary upper range.
